title: the landing
caption: The door closes behind you and stays where it is, in the middle of a field.

hotspots.label: The column of light beneath the craft
The door standing alone in the grass
A hatch on the underside of the craft
hotspots.text: The hatch irises shut, then open, then shut. It is not for you.

hotspots.label: The dome on top of the craft
hotspots.text: Something inside the dome moves to the other side of the glass to keep looking at you.

hotspots.label: The moon
hotspots.text: The moon is full, and the wrong way round, and you cannot say how you know.

hotspots.label: A shape crouched in the grass
hotspots.text: The grass moves against the wind. Whatever was there is nearer now.

hotspots.label: The trees at the edge of the field
